company.name: Rhoda AI
company.shortDescription: Rhoda AI is a tech company that develops a class of robot foundation models designed to bring general intelligence into the physical world.
company.description: Rhoda is builds a robot foundation model designed to bring general intelligence into the physical world. By combining internet-scale video pretraining with closed-loop video predictive control, Rhoda aims to enable robots that can adapt, generalize, and operate autonomously across real-world environments. The company works with leading industrial partners across manufacturing and logistics.

productsAndServices.description: A general-purpose robotic foundation model that enables robots to perform and adapt to industrial tasks using web-scale video pre-training and robot-collected action data.
productsAndServices.name: FutureVision

productsAndServices.description: A physical robotic platform designed to execute industrial tasks with high payload capacity, actuator-level braking, safety-rated vision, and long-term operating reliability.
productsAndServices.name: Robot Platform

productsAndServices.description: Deployment of adaptive robotic systems for variable commercial and industrial workflows, including logistics, manufacturing, automotive, and ecommerce operations.
productsAndServices.name: Industrial Robotic Automation Deployment
